purpose: Define a rebuildable, provenance-preserving scientific-state projection that can reconstruct research reasoning, evidence lineage, review/authority boundaries, and candidate next actions from durable workspace-control and research-engine records without becoming a new source of scientific truth or executor authority.

authoritative_inputs: workspace-control task capsules and synchronized handoffs
scientific execution reports and content-addressed artifacts
independent review checkpoints/comments when durably consumed
Git commit/PR/run/job identities and execution receipts

epistemic.purpose: Represent what is observed, hypothesized, supported, rejected, unresolved, contradicted, or interpreted.

normative.purpose: Represent explicit reviewed constraints, gates, permissions, prohibitions, stopping rules, and reopening rules sourced from authority-owned artifacts.
normative.critical_rule: No inferred/model-generated graph edge may create or widen a Permission, remove a Prohibition, satisfy a ReviewRequirement, or authorize executor action.

execution.purpose: Represent what was actually implemented, validated, triggered, run, merged, produced, or received.

decision_bridge.rule: The projection may rank or explain CandidateAction objects, but only an existing authority-owned policy/task contract may return an executable ALLOW.

assertion_metadata_contract.provenance_rule: Every projected node/edge must retain at least one exact source reference; derived assertions must retain all immediate parent assertion IDs and their source references.
assertion_metadata_contract.contradiction_rule: Contradictory assertions remain simultaneously representable with source, time, and authority metadata. Projection code must not silently choose one truth value.
assertion_metadata_contract.supersession_rule: Supersession changes current-view selection but never deletes historical assertions.

source_precedence_contract.purpose: Resolve current-state views without rewriting history.
precedence: exact durable authority artifact explicitly named by governing task contract
merged authoritative task capsule at the pinned workspace-control snapshot
merged design/result artifact at exact commit/blob identity
open PR or unmerged branch state
source_precedence_contract.stale_state_rule: A lower-precedence or older assertion remains queryable as historical state but must not override a newer authoritative source in CURRENT_STATE queries.
source_precedence_contract.validation_unavailable_rule: A zero-step/pre-runner CI failure is VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE, never PASS and never a scientific negative.

required_distinctions: negative scientific result vs invalid execution
preregistered verdict vs posthoc non-verdict evidence
design authority vs implementation authority vs trigger authority vs production authority
scientific scope permission vs executor permission
blocked evidence vs rejected mechanism vs incomplete validation
current authoritative state vs stale historical handoff
research_state_model.candidate_action_rule: Candidate next actions may be generated only from current residuals, live hypotheses, explicit constraints, and reviewed authority edges; rejected/reopened families must carry their reopening condition.

bounded_query_contract.ontology_slice_rule: Queries retrieve only the bounded classes/relations necessary to answer the question; full-graph prompt injection is forbidden.

before_implementation: independent review of this exact ontology and replay-benchmark contract
successful workspace-control validation of task/design artifacts
first_implementation_scope: no graph database migration; use file/in-memory or existing relational projection first

blind_replay_contract.projection_source_rule: Projection construction may read only the exact authoritative source bindings and referenced durable artifacts. It must not read the replay benchmark file, expected answers, case IDs, or forbidden claims.
blind_replay_contract.query_engine_rule: The primary evaluator is model-free and receives only a frozen structured query_input plus the projected graph/current-state view. Natural-language question text is display-only.
blind_replay_contract.evaluation_rule: The test harness may read expected_answer_class, required_points, forbidden_claims, and source_identities only after the query engine has produced its answer.
blind_replay_contract.failure_semantics: Any benchmark-specific hardcoding, expected-label visibility, or use of the benchmark as projection input invalidates the replay result rather than counting as a PASS.
